title: What If a Kilometer-Wide Asteroid Hit Earth?

scenes.text: What if an asteroid a kilometer wide hit Earth? The impact isn't the deadliest part.
It would release roughly eighty thousand megatons of TNT in seconds, digging a crater miles deep.
Within minutes, hot rock thrown into the sky would rain back down and could ignite wildfires.
Within days, fine dust and smoke would rise high into the air and could block sunlight for months, even years.
Then comes the cold. Failed harvests for several years, like the famine after the Tambora eruption in eighteen sixteen.
Experts say it could kill many millions. The good news: telescopes have found most asteroids this big, and hits come only every hundred thousand years or more.
